title: Fractera Data — the database of your node
description: The database every element of the node uses: tables, the deploy journal and the log of agent conversations. Programs reach it with the node key.

blocks.title: The database of your node
blocks.description: Every element of the node keeps its tables here. Programs talk to it with the node key; this page only presents it.

items: One door to the tables of every element
Only programs of this machine get in, and only with the node key
Files and vectors live in their own elements next to it

blocks.text: Elements read and write rows through /db/tables. Only the machine key may change the schema.
Every deploy of an element leaves a record: when it ran, how long it took and how it ended.
Agents of the node write down what they asked each other and what they answered. The last 10,000 entries are kept.
A service reaches another service of this machine by name, through /service/<name>, with the same key.

Files and images moved to the storage element, vectors to the vectors element. The old addresses /media and /vectors still work here: the request goes to the new element and its answer comes back unchanged.
